abilities.effect: The guards ready and load the ballista. The ballista defense then rolls Initiative.
abilities.name: Ready and Load
abilities.trigger: The alarm is raised while the PCs are approaching the Palace

hazard.description: A ballista armed with a massive bolt fires on a creature approaching the Palace.
hazard.disable: DC 36 Thievery (master) to sabotage the ballista by reaching through the firing slit from outside (this DC is reduced by 10 if the PCs are in the room with the ballista), or DC 33 Intimidation to frighten off the Pitax Warden operating the ballista.
hazard.name: Ballista Defense
hazard.reset: (1 day) If the PCs haven't reached 30 Liberation Points, additional ammunition for a ballista can be secured in a day, but if the PCs have reached 30 Liberation Points, a ballista that runs out of ammo cannot be reset.
hazard.routine: (3 actions) The ballista takes 1 action to fire a ballista bolt and 2 actions to reload. After ten rounds, the ballista is out of ammunition and can no longer function.

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Mechanical
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a constructed physical object.
